checks.requirement: Three output files must be saved

checks.check: learned_mrf.csv: 8 lines of node1,node2, valid capital names, no self-loops, no duplicates
checks.requirement: Exactly 8 edges ... each edge should appear only once; node names are case-sensitive

checks.check: V degree strictly greater than any other node
checks.requirement: node V must have the highest degree
checks.note: old check depended on dict order for ties

checks.check: edge set equals top-8 |partial correlation| pairs of /app/mrf_sample_10k.csv (asserted only if 8th/9th gap >3x)
checks.requirement: Recover the underlying graphical structure of the MRF. The true graph has exactly 8 edges
checks.note: partial correlation thresholding named by task; glasso alpha .02-.1 and GraphicalLassoCV give identical set; gap .198 vs .021

checks.check: inferred_marginals header w_value,probability, numeric, >=2 unique values, p>=0, sum in [0.95,1.05]
checks.requirement: CSV with header w_value,probability ... probabilities should sum to approximately 1.0

checks.check: samples: 10000 rows, all 8 columns numeric finite
checks.requirement: Exactly 10,000 rows ... header row containing all 8 node names

checks.check: <1% of sample rows are exact rows of the observed data
checks.requirement: Generate 10,000 samples from the learned MRF model

checks.check: in samples, |partial corr| < 0.08 for every pair not in learned_mrf.csv
checks.requirement: Generated samples should follow the learned distribution

checks.check: mean/sd of inferred_marginals within 0.06 / 20% of Gaussian conditional W|V=1,X=0.5 implied by the solver's own samples
checks.requirement: The conditional inference should properly account for the evidence V=1.0 and X=0.5; Generated samples should follow the learned distribution
checks.note: internal consistency between two outputs of the same learned model; not an expected value

contested.verifier_expects: no fixed value (only consistency with own samples)
contested.why: depends on parameter estimator / glasso regularisation (0.05-0.20 across alpha 0.1-0), which the task does not fix
